description: A litigation director must approve an emergency court application against a former employee accused of taking proprietary engineering materials, including the filing timing, requested relief, forensic scope, and insurance-related steps, with input from litigation, forensic, client-relations, and insurance specialists.

shared_context.S1: A former senior engineer left the company last week and is now working for a direct competitor.
shared_context.S2: The company believes proprietary engineering materials may have been copied before the engineer's departure.
shared_context.S3: Elena Marquez has authority to approve the proposed emergency court application and its requested terms.
shared_context.S4: The firm's pre-motion review routine requires the litigation director to obtain and record a formal area report from litigation, forensic discovery, client-relations, and insurance counsel before approving the application.

PF1.text: Thomas confirmed with the assigned judge's clerk this morning that any emergency application based on these facts must be filed by 5:00 p.m. on October 9, 2026 to receive the available hearing date; he has not yet updated the draft motion cover sheet.

PF2.text: Nadia's forensic imaging review, completed yesterday from the company laptop, identified exactly 23 copied files in the Alpha repository and build scripts, while the unrelated product repositories showed no copied files; she has not yet added the result to the discovery report.

PF3.text: Marcus learned during the client's executive call yesterday that the client will not authorize a request barring the former engineer from working for the competitor, but specifically requires return and deletion of the 23 copied files and a prohibition on using them.

PF4.text: Sofia's review of the applicable cyber policy confirmed that the insurer must receive notice before any court filing and must consent in writing before the company engages an outside forensic expert whose fees will be claimed as covered defense costs; she received the policy endorsement yesterday but has not circulated her coverage note.

acceptance_conditions: The emergency application must be approved for filing by October 9, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
The requested forensic scope must address exactly 23 copied files in the Alpha repository and build scripts and must not broaden the forensic work to unrelated repositories.

The requested relief must require return and deletion of the 23 copied files and prohibit their use, and the application must not request a bar on the former engineer's employment with the competitor.
The insurer must be notified before filing.
The policy requirement for written insurer consent before engaging an outside forensic expert must be reflected in the decision.

content_checks.C1: decisions['file_emergency_application'] == True and (('October 9, 2026' in decisions['file_by'] and '5:00 p.m.' in decisions['file_by']) or decisions['file_by'] == '2026-10-09T17:00:00')
content_checks.C2: ('23' in decisions['forensic_scope'] or 'twenty-three' in decisions['forensic_scope']) and (('Alpha repository' in decisions['forensic_scope']) or ('Alpha' in decisions['forensic_scope'])) and (('build scripts' in decisions['forensic_scope']) or ('build' in decisions['forensic_scope']))
content_checks.C3: decisions['bar_competitor_employment'] == False and ('23 copied files' in decisions['requested_relief']) and (('return and deletion' in decisions['requested_relief']) or ('return' in decisions['requested_relief'] and 'deletion' in decisions['requested_relief'])) and (('prohibition' in decisions['requested_relief']) or ('prohibit' in decisions['requested_relief']))

decisive_facts.why: The clerk's confirmation changes the filing plan to the exact October 9, 2026 5:00 p.m. deadline and supplies the fact that must be cited for that deadline.
The forensic imaging changes the application from a broad or unsupported scope to one naming 23 copied files in the Alpha repository and build scripts.
The client's instruction changes the requested relief to return and deletion of the 23 copied files with a prohibition on their use, while excluding any competitor-employment bar.

The policy endorsement changes the filing plan by requiring insurer notice before filing and changes the policy decision to record written insurer consent as a requirement before outside forensic engagement.
